title.en: An Act to Authorize the Sale of the Lands, Buildings and Other Improvements of Bilibid Prison and the Establishment of a New Insular Prison Outside the City of Manila.

text.en:
Whenever in his opinion the public interests will be promoted thereby, the Governor-General,
upon the recommendation of the Secretary of Justice and the Secretary of Agriculture and Natural Resources,
.may authorize the sale of the lands, buildings and other improvements of Bilibid Prison for such amount and
upon such terms and conditions as may be approved by the Council of State, and execute the necessary deed
or deeds of conveyance: Provided, That from the savings of the Bureau of Prisons there shall be paid to the
San Lazaro Investment Fund the sum of one hundred seventy-nine thousand two hundred and sixty-five pesos
within fifteen years from the date of said sale.

The proceeds from the sale of the property mentioned in section one shall be available for
expenditure by the Director of Prisons, with the approval of the Secretary of Justice, for the purpose of
purchasing a new prison site outside the City of Manila; for the construction of buildings and other necessary
structures suitable for a modern penitentiary; for the purchase of the necessary equipment and supplies; and
for salaries and such other expenses as may be deemed necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 3, 1932.
